## History

Richard Keith was the relative of the twins David and [Dora](../character/dora.md) Keith. He died of consumption, a fact communicated to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) by a friend a fortnight after his passing. In his will, he left a trust fund of two thousand dollars to [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) for David and [Dora](../character/dora.md). This financial provision ensured that the twins could remain permanently at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P0](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0000), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P3](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0003), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P5](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0005), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P6](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0006), +20 more_
